svg.title: How news of one fight reaches each rank: who hears, when, from whom, and how true
svg.text: HOW NEWS OF ONE FIGHT REACHES EACH RANK
The fight at the ford at Camia. The ford was lost, the right wing broke, and some two thousand fell. Here is who learns what, when, from whom, and how true.
at Aldhaven, nine days' ride away
his host three days off; a rival
on a hill behind the centre
the soldier's village, far to the west
the captain writes to the family
the crown tells the realm its own version
the General writes to the king
going down: what to do, less of why
The length of the road, over the speed of whoever carries it:
a galloper relay about 100 km a day, a courier 50, a pedlar 25.
A cut road or a siege ring stops it. A rider can be taken.
1 Those who need it: the sender's own superior, the chain.
2 Those he is bound to: a friend on the staff, a patron.
3 Those who matter: a duke hears before a captain.
What the sender saw, bent by what he wants you to think,
bent again by every mouth it passed through.
A king men fear is told what he wants to hear.
